page.overview:
Who is Ammosaurus?

is an extinct genus of prosauropod dinosaur from the Early Jurassic in the United States that might be a synonym of Anchisaurus. It was not a very known dinosaur.

Ammosaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. However, it would receive a profile in the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.

It is shown building a nest with its feet, a reference to its name, which means "Sand Lizard".
